events.text: Herod the Great rules for Rome and rebuilds the temple.
Jesus is crucified and rises (about AD 30).
The church spreads from Jerusalem across the empire.
Revolt against Rome from AD 66; the temple destroyed in AD 70.
Nero is emperor from AD 54; slaves are a large part of the population of cities such as Colossae.
A year of civil war, then Vespasian.
Written from prison, probably AD 60 to 62, with Colossians and Ephesians

teaser.title: Paul in prison
teaser.text: Acts ends with Paul under house arrest in Rome, about AD 60 to 62.

teaser.title: Philemon is written
teaser.text: Paul writes to Philemon and sends Onesimus back, at about the same time as Colossians.

teaser.title: Colossians is sent
teaser.text: Tychicus carries the letter, with Onesimus (Colossians 4:7-9).

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.
